purpose: Ingest high-value cross-domain sources surfaced by the 41494/44491/44194/94044/40449/44109/14904/91404 raw block, especially additive-manufacturing powder reuse, big-data governance, maintenance standardization, manufacturing operator skills, software defects, targeted assembly and inter-operator transaction interfaces.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, software resource, operational precedent, commercial signal or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Mirrors, reseller pages, alternate bibliographic records and derivative summaries of the same underlying source are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Standards numbers, CVE IDs, software problem-note IDs, postal codes, catalogue numbers and bibliographic identifiers may be useful to Worldshepherd but are not Glob evidence unless the digits independently encode a verified physical quantity.

sources.title: GB/T 44194-2024 — Additive manufacturing—Technical specification for reuse of metal powder
sources.authority: State Administration for Market Regulation / Standardization Administration of China
sources.note: Current national standard. Use as a powder-reuse governance reference for additive manufacturing, including reuse strategy, inspection/testing and process-control requirements. 44194 is the standard number.

sources.title: GB/T 44109-2024 — Information technology—Big data—Guidelines of data governance implementation
sources.authority: State Administration for Market Regulation / Standardization Administration of China
sources.note: Current national standard. Use as an external implementation reference when formalizing Worldshepherd data governance, quality, responsibility and lifecycle controls. 44109 is the standard number.

sources.title: DIN SPEC 91404 — Guideline for the standardization of maintenance processes
sources.note: DIN lists the technical rule as current. Use to normalize maintenance-process definitions and interfaces alongside S3000L lifecycle-support analysis. 91404 is the specification number.

sources.title: Skill standard 40449 — Operate valves in an energy and chemical plant
sources.note: Use operator competence/task qualification and valve-operation safety concepts as an operations-training reference. 40449 is the skill-standard identifier.

sources.title: CVE-2021-44491 — YottaDB incorrect calculation leading to crash
sources.note: Use integer/size-calculation failure as a robustness/security test case for input-driven memory-operation bounds. 44491 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: SAS Problem Note 40449 — ANYDTDTE period parsing defect
sources.note: Use as a regression-test precedent showing how ambiguous/malformed input can change behavior between software releases. 40449 is the problem-note identifier.

sources.title: SAS Problem Note 41494 — query-parameter data-set locking defect
sources.note: Use as an application-state/locking regression precedent. The 41494 problem-note number is independent of already-established physical 41494 evidence.

sources.title: PRICE: Software for the Targeted Assembly of Components of (Meta) Genomic Sequence Data
sources.note: Use its iterative targeted-data retrieval, localized assembly and redundancy-collapse/meta-assembly pattern as a reusable data-processing algorithm. 94044 is only the authors' affiliation postal code.

sources.title: ISO/TS 14904:2002 — Electronic fee collection interface specification for clearing between operators
sources.note: Withdrawn technical specification, retained as a historical interoperability/security/privacy design reference for multi-operator clearing and transaction exchange. 14904 is the specification number.

information_updates.finding: GB/T 44194-2024 provides a directly relevant external control framework for metal-powder reuse in additive manufacturing, which should be cross-walked against Worldshepherd powder genealogy, contamination, lot tracking, inspection and reuse-cycle controls.
information_updates.claims_boundary: This improves production governance but 44194 remains metadata-only Glob evidence.

information_updates.finding: GB/T 44109-2024 gives Worldshepherd an additional standards-based data-governance implementation reference that can complement source lineage, claims control, access responsibility and quality-management requirements already present in SARA/ECHO/PRIME.

DIN SPEC 91404 maintenance-process standardization, S3000L logistic-support analysis and OPC/ISA-95 production semantics form a useful three-layer lifecycle stack: production objects and data, standardized maintenance workflows, and lifecycle support/resource analysis.
information_updates.claims_boundary: This is a Worldshepherd architecture inference from independent standards sources, not a Glob-number relation.

information_updates.finding: PRICE demonstrates a generalizable iterative pattern for narrowing large heterogeneous data reservoirs around a declared target, running local reconstruction, then deduplicating results; that pattern can inform Worldshepherd evidence discovery and data-reconciliation workflows.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The algorithmic analogy does not validate any number permutation.

next_actions: Cross-walk GB/T 44194 powder-reuse concepts against Worldshepherd additive-manufacturing powder genealogy, inspection and contamination-control requirements without claiming formal conformity.
Continue raw scanning across the remaining three-family union states and source-by-source retroactive utility backfill.
Continue same-system topology and relational verification independently for the physical 41494/W II and other P1/P2 evidence neighborhoods.
Maintain fixed tolerance and experiment-wide multiple-testing/false-discovery controls for numerical evidence promotion.
